description: Land Acquisition - Pitipana North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1979/17 of 13.02.2013, Ambagamuwa Korale D/S Division,
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
